# Caption

`scaffolds/caption` · caption · v0.1.0

Kicker with a short accent rule over a display line, in the layout caption area; each cue rises in and fades out.

![Caption preview — editorial theme, at 0.6 s, desktop sample screen](preview.png)

*Preview: the editorial theme, 0.6 s into the component, over the desktop sample screen; the manifest's preview samples.*

## Slots

| slot | type | default from | max chars | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | text | scene.caption.text | 90 | Caption line (when no cues are given). |
| `kicker` | text | scene.caption.kicker | 40 | Small line above the caption. |

## Params

| param | type | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `align` | `center` \| `left` | center | Alignment in the caption area. |
| `max_lines` | integer (1–3) | 2 | Lines before the text shrinks. |
| `rule` | boolean | true | Short accent rule before the kicker. |

- variants: landscape, vertical
- theme tokens: `colors.accent`, `colors.text`, `fonts.display`, `fonts.body`, `captions.kicker`, `captions.line`
